newsitem.title: USA: Total court application set for June 26.
newsitem.headline: Total court application set for June 26.

text.p: Total Petroleum (North America) Ltd said Tuesday that the application for final court approval of its plan to be acquired by Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp is scheduled for June 26.

Earlier, Ultramar Diamond Shamrock said Total shareholders had approved the acquisition. Total said in a separate statement that more than 99 percent of the common shares were voted in favor of the deal at a shareholders meeting held in Canada.
Total said that at a separate meeting, its board deferred consideration of its regular third quarter dividend to coordinate with the third quarter dividend of Ultramar Diamond Shamrock.
